profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (SDE III) at Amazon
profile.summary: I have a special hankering for designing and building products backed by scalable distributed systems with low operational burden.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (SDE III)
positions.description:
I'm currently building the next generation of AI-powered experiences for Alexa.com and the Alexa mobile app, helping redefine how millions of customers interact with Alexa.

In the Physical Stores organization (2020-2021), I led design and implementation of the next generation POS software for Amazon's special retail stores (4-star, Books, and Pop-Up).

In the Whole Foods Tech organization (2018-2020), I led design and implementation of an Android app and OpenAPI-based web service that Whole Foods team members used to map product location data for downstream use by Alexa shopping list users and PrimeNow shoppers.

In the Alexa Shopping organization (2016-2018), I led design and implementation of the RESTful API and authentication protocol for the Amazon's second generation Dash Wand IoT device and led design and implementation of the Alexa shopping cart experience.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description: As an engineer on the Amazon Dash team, I helped design and implement of the server-side stack for the original Dash Wand, Amazon's first IoT device and first voice device.

positions.title: Software Development Manager II
positions.description: As the manager of the Kindle Store organization's Platform Services team, I led 10 engineers to launch many successful projects, while driving down operational costs.

positions.title: Web Development Engineer II
positions.description: As an engineer on the Kindle Content Store team, I led front-end development of Kindle Textbook Rentals and Kindle eBook Gifting, contributed to launching the first international Kindle Store on Amazon.co.uk, helped build a new HTML5-based store on the Kindle Touch, maintained the Kindle Store on Amazon.com and all existing Kindle devices.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: I developed and assisted designing a new social networking platform using PHP and JavaScript.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description: I maintained and improved an internal PHP-based web application for managing proposals, projects, accounts, vendors, study samples, and billing reports that was integral to the business' daily operations.

positions.title: Web Developer / Server Administrator
positions.description: I deployed and administered GNU/Linux web, database, and email servers. I designed, developed, and maintained multiple e-commerce and content management solutions using PHP, ASP, and ASP.NET. I developed a new e-commerce solution  for Storm Bowling (using Zend Framework) that doubled their online sales.

positions.title: Web Developer / Designer
positions.description: I designed and developed web sites and applications using PHP 4/5 for small-to-medium size businesses.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I developed and maintained high-traffic e-commerce websites, and optimized web sites for search engines.

positions.title: Technical Writer / Editor
positions.description: I wrote software documentation and release notes for end users, wrote documentation for proprietary helpdesk software, and edited documentation for other writers.

volunteerExperiences.role: President of the Board of Directors
volunteerExperiences.description:
As Board President of Heronwood Estates HOA, I led governance and operations for a 57-home community with an annual budget of approximately $10,000. I facilitated board meetings, managed vendor contracts, handled homeowner disputes, and coordinated grant applications.

I oversaw the first homeowner-approved budget increase in two decades, addressing rising operating costs and supporting the association’s long-term financial sustainability.

I digitized the HOA’s historical documents and published them through the community website, improving transparency and access to governing records.

I managed the association’s website and communications, continuing to serve as webmaster after completing my term as president.

volunteerExperiences.role: Member of the Board of Advisors
volunteerExperiences.description:
As a member of the LifeWise Gig Harbor Advisory Board, I support the delivery and growth of a Bible-based education program currently serving three elementary schools in the Peninsula School District.

I lead logistics efforts focused on identifying and developing partnerships with local churches to host LifeWise classes.

I support fundraising and community outreach by presenting the program’s mission, operations, and needs to local churches.

I collaborate with fellow advisory board members to expand program capacity and strengthen partnerships that support participating students and families.
